name: realm
description: Obsidian project-knowledge & decision memory pipeline for Gemini, Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Turn your codebase decisions into a living Obsidian knowledge vault.
interface.longDescription: Realm persists architectural decisions (ADRs), high-level planning, god-file concierge triage, and organization facts as interlinked nodes in an Obsidian vault.
defaultPrompt: Bootstrap Realm vault for this project using /realm-forge.
Recall the auth decisions from the Realm vault using /realm-recall 'why JWT'.
Plan the new API feature using two-phase /realm-planning.
Scan oversized god files for triage using /realm-concise.
